title: adr (0097): the degraded-instance section still says every husk's dispatch refusal promises "the platform retries automatically"; held instances (#27992, #27237) are not retried
body:
domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czuTWNgKR22fKv7jia

Filing gate: ① a governed record that will contradict the runtime at a named location. Found by the #28016 card thread (PR #28037) and filed by the `domain:server` seat. `docs/adr/` is governed, so this is not edited in that PR. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Drift (lands with PR #28037)

`docs/adr/0097-declarative-connector-instances.md:186-190` says a degraded instance's husk makes a `connector_action` dispatch fail "with the reason and 'the platform retries automatically'".

Since PR #28014 (#27992), and before it #27237 for a refused stored credential, some degraded instances are **held**: the backoff does not retry them, and only an edit of the declaration, setting the credential again, or a restart re-attempts them. PR #28037 (#28016) makes the refusal say so. "Retries automatically" stays only for an instance on the backoff.

## Wanted

A dated amendment in the ADR's own convention. It should say the refusal names the recovery: automatic on the backoff, or the edit or credential that a held instance waits for. It should cite #27992, #27237 and #28016. The ADR's later backoff bullet (:193) may need the held exception stated too.

⛔ This is a governed path. It lands with a GOVERNED_APPROVER, and not before PR #28037 merges.

## Dedupe

#28016 / PR #28037, #27992 / PR #28014, #27237. No open card covers ADR-0097's degraded section.
